name: Team activity
description: Who has how much, and when it is due.
long_description:
A read-only picture of the initiative's workload. How much each person is carrying and how urgent it is, what lands on whom week by week, the daily rhythm of what gets finished, and who is carrying what — with the finished and open totals as the headline.

Work past its due date counts in the current week, because that is when it still has to be done.

Nothing here needs setting up — every widget reads the initiative the dashboard lives on.
release_notes: Open work by person is split by priority, and a new chart shows what each person has due week by week over the next eight weeks, with overdue work in the current week. It replaces Open work by priority, which the first chart now shows.

binding.sql: SELECT count(*) AS finished FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false
SELECT count(*) AS open FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false

SELECT date_trunc('day', tasks.completed_at) AS day, count(*) AS finished FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false GROUP BY date_trunc('day', tasks.completed_at) ORDER BY date_trunc('day', tasks.completed_at)

SELECT assignee.display_name AS person, priority, count(*) AS open FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false GROUP BY assignee.display_name, priority ORDER BY assignee.display_name, priority

SELECT date_trunc('week', greatest(due_date, now())) AS week, assignee.display_name AS person, count(*) AS due FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false AND due_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date < now() + CAST('56 days' AS interval) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT concat(project.name, ' · ', title) AS card, assignee.display_name AS person, due_date FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false ORDER BY project.name, due_date
